name: flutter-secure-dev-playbook
description: Comprehensive, version-accurate Flutter & Dart development and security reference for Claude Code — widgets & layout, state management (BLoC/Cubit), navigation, forms (formz), Material 3 theming, REST/http, WebSockets, Firebase auth + FCM, maps & location, in-app purchases, animations, testing, performance, build/deploy, plus a full Secure SDLC / DevSecOps layer: OWASP MASVS/ASVS, STRIDE/PASTA threat modeling, CWE mapping, AAA/CIA, and production security ops. A SKILL.md router plus 27 on-demand reference files.
